track-width.$description: dimension used by the switch component for track width.

track-height.$description: dimension used by the switch component for track height.

thumb-size.$description: dimension used by the switch component for thumb size.

thumb-width.$description: dimension used by the switch component for thumb inline size (MarsUI md pointer is 22x18 — wider than tall; thumb-size remains the block size).

thumb-inset.$description: dimension used by the switch component for thumb inset.

gap.$description: dimension used by the switch component for gap (MarsUI sm label pairing: Space/md 8px).

track-radius.$description: dimension used by the switch component for track radius.

thumb-radius.$description: dimension used by the switch component for thumb radius (MarsUI pointer corner radius is half the height with corner smoothing; radius_round clamps to the smoothed pill).

border-width.$description: dimension used by the switch component for border width (MarsUI tracks are borderless; the 1px hairline in ki.outline.control is the declared WCAG 1.4.11 deviation at half the former weight, so the control stops reading as an outlined pill).

min-target.$description: dimension used by the switch component for min target (MarsUI component frame is 28px tall for sm/md — the designed interactive footprint).

glyph-width.$description: dimension used by the switch component for the thumb state glyph inline size (Figma pointer exports: 8px check/dash ink box inside the thumb).

glyph-height.$description: dimension used by the switch component for the thumb state glyph block size (Figma pointer exports: 4px check ink height).

glyph-dash-height.$description: dimension used by the switch component for the disabled dash glyph block size (Figma pointer exports: 8x2 rounded dash).

track.$description: color used by the switch component for unchecked rest track (MarsUI OFF track = surface/disabled_med_em #dddfe4 light / White-18 dark — a solid soft fill, not an outlined pill).

thumb.$description: color used by the switch component for unchecked rest thumb.

border.$description: color used by the switch component for unchecked rest border.

track.$description: color used by the switch component for unchecked hover track (Kimen-invented one-step ramp over the corrected rest fill; the master defines no hover variant).

thumb.$description: color used by the switch component for unchecked hover thumb.

border.$description: color used by the switch component for unchecked hover border.

track.$description: color used by the switch component for unchecked active track (one step beyond hover; the master defines no pressed variant).

thumb.$description: color used by the switch component for unchecked active thumb.

border.$description: color used by the switch component for unchecked active border.

track.$description: color used by the switch component for unchecked disabled track (MarsUI disabled track keeps the OFF rest fill surface/disabled_med_em; the disabled signal lives in the glyph in the master).

thumb.$description: color used by the switch component for unchecked disabled thumb (MarsUI pointer keeps its light construction in every state including disabled).

border.$description: color used by the switch component for unchecked disabled border.

track.$description: color used by the switch component for checked rest track.

thumb.$description: color used by the switch component for checked rest thumb.

border.$description: color used by the switch component for checked rest border.

track.$description: color used by the switch component for checked hover track.

thumb.$description: color used by the switch component for checked hover thumb.

border.$description: color used by the switch component for checked hover border.

track.$description: color used by the switch component for checked active track.

thumb.$description: color used by the switch component for checked active thumb.

border.$description: color used by the switch component for checked active border.

track.$description: color used by the switch component for checked disabled track (MarsUI disabled track keeps the OFF rest fill surface/disabled_med_em; the disabled signal lives in the glyph in the master).

thumb.$description: color used by the switch component for checked disabled thumb (MarsUI pointer keeps its light construction in every state including disabled).

border.$description: color used by the switch component for checked disabled border.

color.$description: color used by the switch component for focus ring color.

width.$description: dimension used by the switch component for focus ring width.

offset.$description: dimension used by the switch component for focus ring offset.

shadow.$description: shadow used by the switch component for the focus ring glow (MarsUI Focus/primary: 3px spread ring at 20% — see ki.focus.primary. specs/002-ki-button/design-extraction.md §2.5 recorded 40%, having read the alpha off the Dark canvas mode, same double mechanism as ki-button: glow plus the opaque indicator).
